column1: # The IANA media type registry: every registered type, carried byte for byte as the registry
# states it. A string literal equal to a row's identifier is the publisher's own identifier
# written into a repository, which is a citation no English word can make; nothing here is an
# English label, so this is never matched against a declared name and never placed as prose.
# Columns: concept, prefLabel, altLabel, broader, kind, module, definition, note.
# concept and prefLabel are the registered template, byte for byte. broader and module name the
# registry the type is filed under. definition is empty for every row because the registry
# publishes none. note carries the registry's reference, and its own deprecation statement where
# it makes one — a deprecated identifier is still the registry's identifier, so the row stays.

# Source: IANA media types, https://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/ (application.csv, audio.csv, font.csv, haptics.csv, image.csv, message.csv, model.csv, multipart.csv, text.csv, video.csv), retrieved 2026-08-19
#   (the registry states no revision, so the file set is the citation, pinned by the SHA-256
#   ContentDigest states over the ten CSVs: fd3eea02e8610628e4a3b6eb0b66a415fdbf973ce1e73e667be24b12cd505aeb).
